title: How is Magnus Carlsen connected to Bill Cipher?
description:
A world chess final, two presidents, a comedy show for troops and a Gravity Falls film-festival panel link Magnus Carlsen to Bill Cipher.

Magnus Carlsen → Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama → Jon Stewart → Kristen Schaal → Alex Hirsch → Bill Cipher

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
